scope: Exact relational key ordering for mixed Boolean/integral/Currency/Decimal and finite binary floats. Engineering key profile, not native Access Variant/grouping qualification.
counting_note: Five new kernel tests, five new query tests and two CLI tests. Existing eight float-kernel and eight query controls counted once; repeat runs are not additive.

new_generated_properties.independent_oracle: Already adopted num-bigint/num-rational; arbitrary exact fractions, separately from production u128 scaled-bit comparison.
properties: full fixed/binary ranges and reverse-order symmetry
dyadic Decimal equality and adjacent Double distinctions

observations.sql: SELECT K FROM (SELECT IIf(Id=1,CDec('0.1'),CDbl(0.1)) AS K FROM (SELECT 1 AS Id UNION ALL SELECT 2) X) Q ORDER BY K
SELECT K FROM (SELECT IIf(Id=1,CLngLng('9007199254740993'),CDbl(9007199254740992)) AS K FROM (SELECT 1 AS Id UNION ALL SELECT 2) X) Q ORDER BY K

baseline.note: Same two representative mixed-key queries refuse with empty stdout on the frozen prechange CLI; focused new query/CLI tests now succeed.

coverage: full supported Decimal scale/coefficient envelope and all fixed numeric families
finite Single/Double extremes, subnormals and signed zeros
all six three-row encounter permutations and both execution profiles
retained carriers and exact LongLong values beyond 2^53
GROUP BY, DISTINCT, dynamic UNION, sorting, TOP ties, Min/Max and domain extrema
fixed crosstab heading membership through the scalar key helper
nonfinite and unrelated Date/Text/Binary family refusals

authoring_corrections: New test used a nonexistent LegacyDateTime::new constructor; corrected to existing from_ole_days.
Cancellation assertion initially accepted only QueryError::Cancelled; explicitly included the existing evaluator-wrapped EvalError::Cancelled channel. No runtime cancellation behavior changed.
Compile-time width assertion rewritten equivalently to satisfy strict int_plus_one lint.
Initial baseline diagnostic expectation used unsupported numeric instead of the existing numeric combination message; corrected the expected substring without product changes.
limits: No native Access SQL execution or heterogeneous Variant grouping qualification.
Static UNION output conversion, scalar predicates, native index formats and stored/write admission remain separate.
No new dependencies, native fixtures or Decimal arithmetic implementation.
No performance claim or benchmark; the new comparator has no payload allocation by construction.
Full P0 Variant/result promotion and native text semantics remain unfinished.
